component.name: Unofficial Muse for Linux
component.summary: An independent Linux-native assistant desktop prototype

description.p: A native GTK4 desktop shell for exploring Linux-local integrations with an assistant backend kept replaceable.

The current prototype includes a session-only, read-only folder grant and bounded UTF-8 text preview. Muse.ai account pairing is not implemented; the experimental developer API path does not provide it. Meta's Linux Device SDK is unsupported and its distribution terms are under review.
